verdict.rationale: Portkey documents gateway-managed keys: provider credentials are stored in the gateway and never exposed in code, a single Portkey API key fronts multiple providers, and API keys can carry budgets and rate limits with workspace-level controls. The docs do not explicitly describe minting separate scoped keys per team or per app, and nothing independent corroborates the vendor claims. missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating and scoping individual keys per team/app (key issuance workflow, per-key permissions), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can mint gateway-managed keys for teams and apps without exposing raw provider keys

citations.quote: Provider credentials stored securely, never exposed in code
One Portkey API key → Access multiple providers → Use hundreds of models
Configure budget and rate limits on API keys to effectively manage AI spending and usage across your organization
Fine-grained control: budgets, rate limits, and model allow-lists at both org and workspace level.
